svg.aria-label: agent-kit: Cheaper agent runs, same prefix every time. The right tier, a finish line, one cached prefix for every brief. Steps: Inline?, a few tool calls: no agent; Tier, haiku, sonnet, or inherit; Build, a fingerprinted outline, locally; Brief, outline first, task and check last; Stats, hit rate per agent, cold ones named. Output: one total hit rate, and which agents missed.
